title: Fix duplicate contacts
ask: The dedupe function in contacts.py is meant to drop repeated email addresses from our mailing list, but people who typed their address with a capital letter or a stray space get two newsletters. Please fix it. Tests are in tests/test_contacts.py.
background: The list is about 900 rows, exported from the shop as dictionaries with an email key.
The first row for each person is the one to keep, since it has their sign-up date.
Ngaire reviews anything that touches the mailing list.

constraints.text: keep the dedupe function to 12 lines or fewer
write a short note on the fix and save it as CHANGELOG.md
give the notes a heading called "What changed"
don't import pandas, it is far too heavy for this
leave no TODO or FIXME comments in contacts.py
don't fetch anything from the web
name Ngaire as the reviewer in the notes
